items.prompt: What does RAII establish in the shown handled-exception path?

options.text: Every external business side effect is rolled back
options.why: Resource destruction is not a transaction protocol.

options.text: Constructed automatic ownership tokens are cleaned up
options.why: The stated stack unwinding invokes their destructors.

options.text: The process cannot ever terminate unexpectedly
options.why: RAII does not promise arbitrary crash/termination cleanup.

options.text: A never-constructed whole object runs its own destructor
options.why: Already constructed subobjects clean up, not the never-completed whole object.

items.explanation: The scope of the claim is fully constructed objects on the demonstrated normal/unwinding exits.
